solution:
Interchanging 3 and 4 gives \(48 \div 4 + 12 \times 3 - 6 \times 7 + 21 = 12 + 36 - 42 + 21 = 27\). Correct.

Check the others: 12 and 21 gives \(16 + 84 - 42 + 12 = 70\); 4 and 7 gives \(16 + 84 - 24 + 21 = 97\); 3 and 6 gives \(8 + 48 - 21 + 21 = 56\).
note: Mathematical Operations: swapping 3 and 6 gives 48/6 + 12x4 - 3x7 + 21 = 56; the check took 3x6 = 18 and printed 59. Key C unchanged.
